nodes.label: Local-First Scope Boundary
nodes.rationale: The service intentionally avoids enterprise features such as built-in authentication, multi-tenancy, distributed execution, and queue back-pressure.

nodes.label: Version 1 Parser Reset
nodes.rationale: Version 1 focuses the product on local vision-first Markdown parsing and removes legacy schema-extraction, provider, evaluation, and MCP APIs.

nodes.label: LangGraph over Bespoke Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: LangGraph provides typed state, streaming, observability hooks, and a smaller contributor learning burden than a custom async orchestrator.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Default Persistence
nodes.rationale: SQLite with WAL matches the local-first single-host deployment model while providing durable concurrent reads and zero infrastructure.

nodes.label: Secure-by-Default Controls
nodes.rationale: Magic-byte validation, loopback-only Ollama, response security headers, and rate limiting make the safe path the default.

nodes.label: V2 Pipeline Review Fix Plan
nodes.rationale: Review findings should be addressed through small, independently verifiable vertical slices with regression tests.
